issues.message: Binding design-intent-and-scope-port has no invoking operation in the selected graph.
No selected canonical blueprint with edge records was returned. Operation order is not a proof of complete canonical semantics.
The reader did not retain a per-cell observation contract. Runtime state is separate and unobserved.
No complete semantic-progress proof was retained. Forward placement must not imply proven monotonicity.
